This opinion is issued pursuant to our engagement letter dated [●], and is based solely on the facts and representations furnished by the management of NovaLeaf Agritech Private Limited, and on the relevant provisions of the Income-tax Act, 1961, applicable rules, notifications, circulars, and judicial precedents as they stand on the date hereof. ## 2. Statement of Facts

NovaLeaf Agritech Private Limited, incorporated in FY 2022-23, develops a proprietary IoT-based soil-monitoring platform and reported turnover of INR 38 crore for the relevant year, within the prescribed threshold. NovaLeaf has DPIIT recognition but has not yet obtained Inter-Ministerial Board (IMB) certification.

## 3. Issue for Consideration

Whether NovaLeaf is eligible for the 100% profit-linked deduction under Section 80-IAC, and what procedural steps remain outstanding.

## 4. Relevant Legal Framework

- Section 80-IAC


## 5. Judicial Precedents Considered

- DPIIT Notification G.S.R. 127(E)

## 6. Analysis

NovaLeaf satisfies the incorporation-date, turnover, and innovative-business-activity criteria under Section 80-IAC in substance. However, the deduction is expressly conditional on certification by the Inter-Ministerial Board confirming that the entity is engaged in innovation, development, or improvement of products, processes, or services, or has a scalable business model with high potential for employment or wealth creation; DPIIT recognition alone is insufficient.

## 7. Conclusion / Opinion

NovaLeaf is prima facie eligible for the Section 80-IAC deduction, but the claim should not be made in the return of income until IMB certification has been obtained.

**Confidence level:** High on substantive eligibility; contingent on procedural certification
